exact_target.forward: For every CM-type A over Qbar satisfying all Hodge classes on every A^n generated by degree-one Hodge classes, and every reduction A0 at a prime of Qbar, must every Tate class on every A0^n be generated by degree-one Tate classes?
exact_target.converse: Exhibit a mathematically specified class of CM-type varieties for which reduction nondegeneracy implies characteristic-zero nondegeneracy, with exact quantifier on the reduction prime.
exact_target.tate_classes: Union over all finite extensions L/Fq of H^{2i}(A0,Q_l(i))^{Gal(Fbar/L)}, l != p. A root-of-unity normalized Frobenius eigenvalue counts after a finite extension.
exact_target.lefschetz: Q or Q_l subalgebra generated by degree-one Hodge or Tate classes on the same power; endomorphisms and divisor algebra may enlarge on reduction.

source_constraints: OWR Theorem1(1) has A simple and End0(A) abelian CM over Q; conclusion concerns each simple factor of reduction.
OWR Theorem1(2)(b) has A simple and place unramified of absolute degree1 on reflex field; then exact A iff A0.

The source already supplies nonempty converse classes, including products of elliptic curves as examples of property(*); novel resolution cannot be inferred merely from proving existence of some class.
CM reduction is interpreted after finite extension giving good reduction (Serre–Tate referenced by source); track actual reduction assumptions rather than literal bad model reduction.
independent_mechanism: Character lattices of CM Mumford–Tate/Hodge torus versus Lefschetz torus; reduction Frobenius torus versus the possibly smaller reduction Lefschetz torus. Translate all-powers class generation into torus equality and test every specialization identification. A dimension loss of Frobenius alone is not sufficient if the reduction Lefschetz torus also loses dimension.
falsifiable_checks: Check quantifier all powers via tensor invariants (including twists), not only one codimension/power.
Check simple versus nonsimple, E=End0 versus chosen CM subfield, and primitive CM types.
For claimed CM-type nondegeneracy, compute full orbit rank of Hodge cocharacter in odd character lattice and verify against an exact rational matrix.
For reductions, compute center of actual geometric End0 and compare divisor/Lefschetz torus after collisions of Frobenius conjugates up to roots of unity.
Any Tate relation uses eigenvalue product equal to q^r times a root of unity; clear roots of unity by a justified finite extension.
CM-type to actual abelian variety requires polarized CM type and a number-field model; reduction needs legitimate good-reduction prime.
Falsify by supersingular, elliptic, split ordinary, repeated-factor and central-involution decomposition boundary cases.
Verify any converse class is nonempty and whether converse is tautological because both sides always true; distinguish that logical answer from a new nontrivial equivalence theorem.
